subcategory_text: Data elements can be accessed for transmission or disclosure.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SC-8 (Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity), AU-6 (Audit Review)
GDPR Art. 15 (Right of access), Art. 20 (Right to data portability)
implementation_examples: Provide authorised recipients (internal compliance functions, data subjects where applicable, supervisory authorities) with a documented path to transmit/disclose data elements with appropriate integrity and confidentiality protections
Maintain an auditable record of transmissions and disclosures
Capture the provenance metadata alongside the transmitted data
assessment_objectives: Determine whether data elements can be transmitted or disclosed on request
Determine whether transmission paths support integrity and confidentiality requirements
Determine whether transmission records are auditable
Determine whether provenance metadata accompanies the transmission
